title: achillea sibirica subsp. ptarmicoides
intro: Achillea sibirica subsp. ptarmicoides, commonly known as Siberian Yarrow or Russian Tarragon, is a perennial herb belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. Its health benefits are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Achillea sibirica subsp. ptarmicoides include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and inflammation.
